title: Universal Life Insurance Valuation Memorandum: Value on Which the Overloan Charge Is Taken
content:
The value on which the overloan protection charge of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is taken follows the number of days from the latest monthly anniversary in the policy's deduction history (the monthly anniversary of the most recent monthly deduction entry) to the charge date.

## Valuation rule

| Days from the latest monthly anniversary to the charge date | Value the charge is taken on |
|---|---|
| **15** or more (the full-carry days) | The account value carried forward by fixed-account interest on the part of the account value above the loan balance, at the tier's current fixed account rate, and by collateral interest on the loan balance at the credited rate of the policy's loan type, both simple for those days over 365 |
| 1 to 14 | The account value carried forward by the fixed-account interest on the part above the loan balance only, simple for those days over 365 |
| 0 (the charge date is the latest monthly anniversary itself) | The account value as shown |

The account value and the loan balance are those on the policy record. The credited rate of the policy's loan type is the tier's preferred loan credited rate from the tier's preferred loan first policy year (policy year **11**, or policy year **6** on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier) and the tier's standard loan credited rate before it; both are **3%** on every tier.

| Tier | Current fixed account rate |
|---|---|
| Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL | 3.5% |
| Ashgrove Protection UL | 3.75% |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL | 4.25% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect | 3.25% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth | 3.25% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier | 3.25% |

## Worked figures (hypothetical, Ashgrove Accumulation UL in policy year 17)

Account value $200000.00, loan balance $190000.00, so $10000.00 above the loan.

| Days since the latest monthly anniversary | Fixed-account interest | Collateral interest | Value the charge is taken on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | $10000.00 times 0.0425 times 20 over 365, $23.2877 | $190000.00 times 0.03 times 20 over 365, $312.3288 | $200335.6164 |
| 15 | $17.4658 | $234.2466 | $200251.7124 |
| 10 | $11.6438 | none | $200011.6438 |
| 0 | none | none | $200000.00 |

The carried value is not rounded on its own.
